title: feat(mix3fill): mixed3=1 holds for 48 of the 96 1-site fillers
science: N_mix3 = 48 = exactly half of the 96 one-site fillers fire mixed3 (the size-12 axis-type (1,1,1) orbit). The result that matters is the REASON given in Theorem 2: 'flipping the mixed3 bit of any filler yields another filler: the 1-site fill dynamics on this patch with off-patch occupancy 0 never uses a mixed3 neighborhood as a lock predicate.' So mixed3 is a dynamically IDLE orbit on this patch -
